# goslop text fixture — CWE-93 numeric/constant-helper header values (safe)
lang: python
file: CWE-93-numeric-call-safe.py
---
import os


def _cache_control_for_scope(scope) -> str:
    raw_path = str(scope.get("path") or "")
    if "/static/" in raw_path:
        return "public, max-age=31536000, immutable"
    return "public, max-age=0, must-revalidate"


def serve(response, direct_path) -> None:
    response.headers["Content-Length"] = os.path.getsize(direct_path)
    response.headers["Cache-Control"] = _cache_control_for_scope({"path": "/x"})
